Details the household pasted in (these win over everything else):
2 Tbs Sun Dried Tomato Oil (from a jar of sun dried tomoatoes)

1 Onion, diced

1 jar Sun Dried Tomatoes, drained and diced

4 Cloves Garlic, minced

3 Tbs Tomato Paste

8 cups Chicken Broth

1 cup Heavy Cream

1 Tbs Basil, chopped or dried is fine I used Basil Paste

Salt, Pepper & Garlic Powder

1 tsp Italian Seasoning

1 tsp Red Pepper Flakes

8 oz Dried Pasta, I used Ziti

3 cups Chopped Spinach

2 cups cooked, shredded, or chopped chicken

8 oz softened Cream Cheese

½ cup Parmesan, grated

Directions:

In a Dutch Oven or heavy-bottomed pot, on medium heat, add your sun dried tomato oil

Once it starts to shimmer, add your onions and cook until translucent

Add your garlic, let it cook until fragrant, about 45 seconds, then stir it in and cook for a few minutes

Add your tomato paste and sun dried tomatoes, stir in and cook until tomato paste has deepened in color

Add chicken broth, cream, basil, salt, pepper & garlic powder, Italian seasoning and red pepper flakes

Bring that up to a boil and let it cook for about 12 minutes, stirring occasionally

Add in your noodles, lower heat to medium low and let that cook until noodles are al dente, about 12 minutes

Lower heat to low, stir in spinach, chicken, cream cheese and parm and cook that stirring through until cheeses are melted

Ladel into bowls, top with a little more grated parm, red pepper flakes and basil and you’re ready to serve

Enjoy!
